sample_unit: dermatologists (5 residents, 4 board-certified, 6 trichology experts) compared with 4 LLMs on trichoscopic images

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of public LLMs versus dermatologists on the same trichoscopic images
links.effect: LLM accuracy 18.2% for suspected diagnosis and 44.4% for SD + DD, versus dermatologists 58.1% and 68.3%; all human-AI differences p < 0.001. Best model Gemini 2.5 Flash reached 62.5% for SD + DD.
links.quote: In trichology, publicly available LLMs currently underperform compared to human experts, especially in providing a single correct diagnosis.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing the diagnostic accuracy of multimodal LLMs against dermatologists on a set of trichoscopic images. It evaluates model accuracy directly without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
